create_model_phi4siglip: create a Phi4ForCausalLMV model with vLLM config for Phi-4 reasoning vision multimodal inference
build_processor_phi4siglip: build a Phi4SiglipMultiModalProcessor that remaps image tokens and generates prompt replacements
test_processing_info: test Phi4SiglipProcessingInfo by computing image token counts from image dimensions and patch size
run_dummy_inputs_builder: run Phi4SiglipDummyInputsBuilder to generate dummy text and images for testing multimodal sequences
